label: nyiso 70 scr edrp reserve
definition: nyiso-70 (KEEPER, promoted over nyiso-68 on rule 1 — most structurally faithful; both runs NOT-YET): nyiso-68 recipe + BOTH lever-3 reserve-supply unions on the energy+reserve co-opt — nyiso_hydro_reserve_eligible (step 1, conventional hydro into full 30-min + quick 10-min, East/NYCA) and the new nyiso_scr_edrp_reserve_eligible (step 2, the SENY tail): the downstate SCR/EDRP demand response already in the fleet ($500 strike, energy-only) is made eligible to SUPPLY the 30-min operating reserve, scoped to NYC + Long_Island + Lower_Hudson. SCR is a NYISO-certified 30-min operating-reserve provider (Ancillary Services Manual §4 / MST §15), so both unions are grounded market-design inputs (rule 1/13), ZERO new tunable (n_residual stays 5). The added downstate reserve headroom absorbs the SENY/NYC-30min ORDC over-spike that leaked into the 2023 LBMP: downstate reserve-shortage zone-hours collapse (2023 915->177, 2024 696->114, 2025 1215->255) and the >$300 downstate tail drops every year, while energy dispatch is essentially unchanged (|dTWh| < 0.09 per class, C1 fuel-mix PASS unchanged - reserve is held, not dispatched). Scorecard vs nyiso-68 (calibration_verdict RT-basis): C3b 2023 0.215->0.198 CLOSES (C3b now PASS all years); C3a 2023 +17.8%->+15.9% and C3c 2023 3.10x->2.20x both IMPROVE but stay just over band; 2024/2025 hold every C3 criterion (LOYO holds). KNOWN REGRESSION (recorded, not hidden): C7 diurnal shape for ST_GAS 2023 flips PASS->FAIL (off-peak CV ratio 0.548->0.483, threshold 0.5) — the extra reserve supply lets ST_GAS provide less reserve, flattening its off-peak dispatch just below the gate; marginal, single-class, confined to the already-NOT-YET 2023 (2024/2025 ST_GAS C7 PASS). Owner-authorized promotion 2026-07-22 with this trade in view. Determination NOT-YET (C3a/C3c/C7 2023): the residual 2023 C3a mean-level gap (+15.9%) is NOT reserve-driven (the full reserve over-spike is only ~1.6% of the mean) - a broad 2023 energy-price LEVEL issue (offer curve / gas basis / import pricing), the separate lever that should also fix the ST_GAS off-peak shape.
